span.label: A NOMENCLATURE, WRITTEN DOWN BECAUSE THE FIELD'S NAMES HAD STOPPED REFERRING RELIABLY - 42 families and 268 compounds given recommended names, acronyms and structural formulas so that industry, science and regulators can mean the same substances by the same words
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **THE PUBLISHED RULE FOR WHEN TWO FIELDS MAY SHARE AN ACRONYM**: `many authors began using the acronym PFC and HAVE DEFINED IT IN MANY DIFFERENT WAYS. As a result, THE MEANING OF THE ACRONYM PFC IS UNCLEAR AND NOT WELL DEFINED ... the acronym PFC has been used in official KYOTO PROTOCOL documents since 1997 to specifically designate PERFLUOROCARBONS. Quotation withheld.` A criterion for tolerable homonymy - distance between the spheres, not the collision itself
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND BOTH DIRECTIONS OF THE MANY-TO-MANY FAILURE, IN ONE SENTENCE: `a given compound has often been denoted by A VARIETY OF DIFFERENT NAMES AND ACRONYMS, or A GIVEN ACRONYM HAS BEEN USED TO REPRESENT DIFFERENT SUBSTANCES. In addition, names to describe broad groups of substances HAVE PROLIFERATED THAT IN SOME INSTANCES MISTAKENLY PORTRAY SUBSTANCES THAT ARE VERY DIFFERENT FROM ONE ANOTHER AS BEING THE SAME. As a result, the scientific literature for these substances HAS AT TIMES BECOME CONFUSING.` One name to many things, one thing to many names, and a third failure where the GROUP name asserts a false identity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE NOMENCLATURE COMPROMISES CORRECTNESS AGAINST INSTALLED USAGE, ON PURPOSE: `We have nevertheless REFRAINED FROM CREATING AN ALL NEW NOMENCLATURE but have retained - as far as possible - THE MOST POPULAR TERMS AND ACRONYMS used by authors to date. In other words, our proposals result from A PRAGMATIC COMPROMISE AMONG TEXTBOOK AND/OR IUPAC CHEMICAL NOMENCLATURE, UNIVERSAL CONSISTENCY, AND FREQUENTLY ADOPTED `LEGACY` USAGE.` The same decision EWGSOP made keeping `sarcopenia`, stated here as a three-way trade-off with the axes named
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND TWO NOMENCLATURES COEXIST BY A DECLARED DIVISION OF LABOUR: `the substance terminology, names and acronyms proposed in this article are IN NO WAY INTENDED TO COMPETE WITH OR SUPPLANT IUPAC OR CAS NOMENCLATURE. The latter names are THE DESIGNATIONS OF CHOICE WHEN A SPECIFIC SUBSTANCE NEEDS TO BE UNEQUIVOCALLY IDENTIFIED, e.g., in official regulatory documents. Our intention is to provide terminology ... FOR PRAGMATIC EVERYDAY USE.` One vocabulary for identification, one for conversation, and the second says so - with the worked example running from a 58-character IUPAC name to the acronym EtFOSE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND AN IDENTIFIER IS OFFERED AS THE REPAIR FOR A NAME: `RIGOR CAN ALWAYS BE ENSURED BY APPENDING THE APPROPRIATE CAS REGISTRY NUMBER when each compound is first mentioned in a publication. We encourage this practice and provide CAS numbers for many commonly discussed compounds.` The convenient name is allowed to be imprecise because a precise key travels beside it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A THRESHOLD IS ADOPTED SPECIFICALLY TO REMOVE SUBJECTIVITY: `PFASs ... are frequently referred to as `LONG-CHAIN` or `SHORT-CHAIN`. TO AVOID ANY SUBJECTIVITY ASSOCIATED WITH THESE ADJECTIVES, we urge scientists to adopt the definition provided by the OECD` - eight carbons and greater for the carboxylic acids, SIX for the sulfonates. Two numbers for one adjective, in one paper
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE TWO NUMBERS DIFFER FOR AN EMPIRICAL REASON, NOT A CHEMICAL ONE: `The `LONG-CHAIN` DEFINITIONS FOR PFCAs AND PFSAs ARE DIFFERENT IN NUMBER OF C ATOMS BECAUSE a PFSA with a given number of carbons HAS A GREATER TENDENCY TO BIOCONCENTRATE AND/OR BIOACCUMULATE than a PFCA with the same number of C atoms.` The class boundary tracks the behaviour the regulators care about, so one word carries two thresholds
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND LEGACY USAGE IS ENCODED DELIBERATELY IN A SUBSET RULE: `IN COMPLIANCE WITH TIME-HONORED USAGE WITHIN THE INDUSTRY, we recommend further that the term `FLUOROPOLYMERS` BE APPLIED ONLY TO A DISTINCT SUBSET of fluorinated polymers, namely, those made by (co)polymerization of olefinic monomers ... to form a carbon-only polymer backbone with F atoms directly attached to it.` The narrower term is kept narrow because the industry already uses it that way
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND FOUR WORDS ARE DECLARED INTERCHANGEABLE WITH A NAMED EXCEPTION: `the terms `SUBSTANCE,` `COMPOUND,` `CHEMICAL,` AND `SPECIES` ARE USED INTERCHANGEABLY for designating a given molecular structure, ALTHOUGH IT IS RECOGNIZED THAT IN OTHER CONTEXTS THEIR MEANINGS MAY NOT BE IDENTICAL. For example, in the European REACH legislation, a `SUBSTANCE` MAY INCLUDE IMPURITIES AND STABILIZERS in addition to the main constituent.` A local synonymy declared, scoped, and shown where it fails
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A NEW AXIS FOR NAME-SPLITTING: LANGUAGE OF PUBLICATION. `Quotation withheld.` Every other split in this corpus runs across disciplines or across time. This one runs across a language boundary, and an English-language review has to name both to be searchable.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A SCIENTIFIC DEFINITION DEFERRING EXPLICITLY TO COMMERCIAL CUSTOM: `Quotation withheld.` The justification is neither composition nor function nor measurability - it is INCUMBENT USAGE IN A COMMERCIAL COMMUNITY, and the paper gives it as sufficient reason.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE NOMENCLATURE HAS TO COVER MORE THAN IT LISTS: `Quotation withheld` `Selected` is the load-bearing word: the families are enumerable, the compounds are not
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE NAMES SIT ON TOP OF A COMBINATORIAL PROBLEM: `PFOS is routinely present in many environmental samples AS A MIXTURE OF THE LINEAR ISOMER AND 10 BRANCHED ISOMERS, WHEREAS 89 CONGENERS ARE THEORETICALLY POSSIBLE.` One recommended name covers eleven observed substances out of eighty-nine possible ones
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the field it is trying to standardise was already producing over four hundred papers a year: `the scientific literature on the environmental and toxicological aspects of PFASs HAS BURGEONED RAPIDLY, and THE RATE OF PUBLICATION CURRENTLY EXCEEDS 400 ARTICLES PER YEAR` - a decade after the first reports. The nomenclature arrives after the usage it must harmonise
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `PFAS` (this paper) - `perfluoroalkyl AND polyfluoroalkyl substances`: aliphatic substances containing the perfluoroalkyl moiety CnF2n+1-, covering BOTH the fully-substituted and the partly-substituted cases
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `PFC` - reserved here EXCLUSIVELY for `perfluorocarbons`, because the Kyoto Protocol has used it that way since 1997; its use for `perfluorochemicals` is called `AN UNFORTUNATE AND INAPPROPRIATE` choice
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `fluoropolymers` vs `fluorinated polymers` - the broad term covers any polymer with F in a monomer unit; the narrow one is restricted to a `DISTINCT SUBSET` by `TIME-HONORED USAGE WITHIN THE INDUSTRY`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `long-chain` - defined numerically by the OECD to remove subjectivity, and with TWO different carbon counts: 8 or more for the carboxylic acids, 6 or more for the sulfonates
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `tenside` / `surfactant` - TWO NAMES FOR ONE THING, SPLIT BY THE LANGUAGE OF THE PUBLISHING COMMUNITY, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO OUTRIGHT: `Quotation withheld.` Not two fields, not two decades - two languages.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PFAS —distinct-from→ PFC
span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `A GIVEN ACRONYM MAY LEGITIMATELY BE USED IN DIFFERENT SPHERES OF ACTIVITY TO DENOTE DIFFERENT CONCEPTS, PROVIDED THESE ACTIVITIES ARE SUFFICIENTLY DISCONNECTED FROM EACH OTHER. However, BOTH PFCs AND PFASs BELONG TO THE OVERALL FAMILY OF FLUORINATED CHEMICALS AND, HENCE, ARE TOO CLOSELY RELATED TO SHARE A COMMON ACRONYM.` This is the rule the corpus lacked for `priming effect` meaning one thing in psychology and another in soil science: the homonymy is fine until the fields touch
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
